name: FindRecords
caption: Find Records

configuration.description: Number of the table to search (e.g. 18 = Customer).

Field filters applied with BC filter syntax before reading. Rows with fieldNo 0 are skipped; if two rows target the same fieldNo the later one wins. The editor saves each row as {fieldNo, filter} only, one row per field.

items.description: Field NUMBER to filter on (any field, including FlowFields that support filtering).

Business Central filter expression as used in SETFILTER / the filter pane, e.g. '10000..20000', '<>0', 'A*|B*', '@*gmbh*', '' (= empty). {{SmartFields}} are resolved against the flow context (never against the records being searched) before the filter is set. The text is cut to 250 characters. For a RecordId field, a value that is exactly one reference SmartField filters on that record directly.

configuration.description: Optional SmartFilter expression (a plain string, NOT JSON) evaluated per found record; only records for which it is true are kept. Inside it, {{FieldName}} refers to the current record's field by its AL field NAME (e.g. {{Balance}}, {{Country/Region Code}}); other {{slug_output}} SmartFields come from the flow context. Grammar: 'left op right' with op one of = != > < >= <= ~ (contains) ^= (starts with) $= (ends with); combine with & / |, wrap EVERY operand of & / | in parentheses, e.g. ({{Blocked}} = ' ') & ({{Balance}} > 1000); negate with !( ... ); '' denotes empty. Comparisons are numeric when both sides parse as numbers, otherwise case-sensitive text.
Maximum number of matching records to return. Missing, null, 0 or negative -> 100. The editor always writes the key.
true = fail the step when no record matches.

Sort key, identified by the comma-joined AL field NAMES of an active table key, without spaces after commas, exactly as declared (e.g. 'Document Type,Sell-to Customer No.'). Empty = primary key. A value that matches no key silently falls back to the primary key. The editor always writes the key (empty string by default).
Read direction of the sort key. true = ascending (default), false = descending.

outputs.name: count
outputs.when: always - number of records returned, as text formatted with the regional settings (values of 1000 and more contain a thousands separator)

outputs.name: results
outputs.when: only when at least one record matched; {{slug_results}} is the first record, {{slug_results[i]}} the i-th (0-based)

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be present and non-zero. The editor's Table field is required.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be an existing table number; 0 or an unknown number fails with Business Central's error when the table is opened.
Write tableNo as a JSON number. A value that cannot be read as an integer counts as 0, and opening table 0 fails.
With errorOnEmpty = true, the step fails when no record passes the field filters and the SmartFilter.
rules.message: No records found in table %1 matching the specified filters.

rules.check: Each resolved filters[].filter must be a valid BC filter expression for the field type, and filters[].fieldNo must exist in the table.
limit should be a JSON integer; other types fall back to 100.
errorOnEmpty should be a JSON boolean; other types fall back to false.
ascending should be a JSON boolean; other types fall back to true.
filters should be a JSON array; other types are ignored (no field filters).
keyFields should be comma-separated field names with no space after the comma; anything that does not exactly match an active key falls back to the primary key without an error.

notes: Sorting is stored as two keys: keyFields (string) + ascending (boolean). The editor's 'sortKey' / 'sortOrder' values are canvas-only and are NOT stored in the configuration.

filters (BC filter syntax, applied by the database) and smartFilter (AutoFlow expression, evaluated per record in AL) are different languages. Prefer filters for performance; the SmartFilter runs after reading and the limit counts only records that pass it.

In smartFilter, record fields are exposed under their AL field Name, formatted with the session's regional settings (decimals/dates). Blob, Media, MediaSet, Guid, RecordId and TableFilter fields and FlowFields (not calculated) are not available.

The SmartFilter evaluator is position-based: without parentheses, '=' is matched before '&' / '|', so 'A = 1 & B = 2' does not work - write '(A = 1) & (B = 2)'. Literal &, |, ( or ) inside operands break parsing.

In smartFilter a '.' inside {{...}} is a path separator and ';' starts a format suffix, so record fields whose AL name contains a dot (e.g. 'No.', 'External Document No.') cannot be referenced as {{FieldName}}; filter on them with filters[] instead.
Field filter SmartFields resolve against the flow context only; to filter by a value of the record being found, use smartFilter.

'results' is a reference ARRAY: use it as the source of a For Each loop, or {{slug_results}} / {{slug_results[0]}} for the first record. When nothing matched, no 'results' value exists and 'count' is '0'.
The step reads only; it does not lock records.

Publish-time dangling-reference check: any {{...}} containing an underscore is treated as {{slug_output}}. A record field name with an underscore used in smartFilter (e.g. {{My_Field}}) therefore triggers a publish warning about an unknown slug.
